targets.rawQueryText: SELECT timestamp_value AS time, metric_value, metric_labels FROM ${_table} qr JOIN clusters c ON qr.cluster_id = c.id WHERE ('${kpi}' = 'All' OR kpi_id = '${kpi}') AND ('${cluster}' = 'All' OR c.cluster_name = '${cluster}') AND ('${cluster_type}' = 'All' OR c.cluster_type = '${cluster_type}') AND ('${filter1_key}' = 'All' OR '${filter1_value}' = 'All' OR json_extract(metric_labels, '$.' || '${filter1_key}') = '${filter1_value}') AND ('${filter2_key}' = 'All' OR '${filter2_value}' = 'All' OR json_extract(metric_labels, '$.' || '${filter2_key}') = '${filter2_value}') AND ('${filter3_key}' = 'All' OR '${filter3_value}' = 'All' OR json_extract(metric_labels, '$.' || '${filter3_key}') = '${filter3_value}') AND timestamp_value >= $__from / 1000 AND timestamp_value < $__to / 1000 ORDER BY time ASC

SELECT 'Max Value' AS metric_labels, MAX(metric_value) AS metric_value, $__from/1000 AS time FROM ${_table} qr JOIN clusters c ON qr.cluster_id = c.id WHERE ('${kpi}' = 'All' OR kpi_id = '${kpi}') AND ('${cluster}' = 'All' OR c.cluster_name = '${cluster}') AND ('${cluster_type}' = 'All' OR c.cluster_type = '${cluster_type}') AND ('${filter1_key}' = 'All' OR '${filter1_value}' = 'All' OR json_extract(metric_labels, '$.' || '${filter1_key}') = '${filter1_value}') AND ('${filter2_key}' = 'All' OR '${filter2_value}' = 'All' OR json_extract(metric_labels, '$.' || '${filter2_key}') = '${filter2_value}') AND ('${filter3_key}' = 'All' OR '${filter3_value}' = 'All' OR json_extract(metric_labels, '$.' || '${filter3_key}') = '${filter3_value}')

SELECT 'Min Value' AS metric_labels, MIN(metric_value) AS metric_value, $__from/1000 AS time FROM ${_table} qr JOIN clusters c ON qr.cluster_id = c.id WHERE ('${kpi}' = 'All' OR kpi_id = '${kpi}') AND ('${cluster}' = 'All' OR c.cluster_name = '${cluster}') AND ('${cluster_type}' = 'All' OR c.cluster_type = '${cluster_type}') AND ('${filter1_key}' = 'All' OR '${filter1_value}' = 'All' OR json_extract(metric_labels, '$.' || '${filter1_key}') = '${filter1_value}') AND ('${filter2_key}' = 'All' OR '${filter2_value}' = 'All' OR json_extract(metric_labels, '$.' || '${filter2_key}') = '${filter2_value}') AND ('${filter3_key}' = 'All' OR '${filter3_value}' = 'All' OR json_extract(metric_labels, '$.' || '${filter3_key}') = '${filter3_value}')

SELECT 'Average Value' AS metric_labels, AVG(metric_value) AS metric_value, $__from/1000 AS time FROM ${_table} qr JOIN clusters c ON qr.cluster_id = c.id WHERE ('${kpi}' = 'All' OR kpi_id = '${kpi}') AND ('${cluster}' = 'All' OR c.cluster_name = '${cluster}') AND ('${cluster_type}' = 'All' OR c.cluster_type = '${cluster_type}') AND ('${filter1_key}' = 'All' OR '${filter1_value}' = 'All' OR json_extract(metric_labels, '$.' || '${filter1_key}') = '${filter1_value}') AND ('${filter2_key}' = 'All' OR '${filter2_value}' = 'All' OR json_extract(metric_labels, '$.' || '${filter2_key}') = '${filter2_value}') AND ('${filter3_key}' = 'All' OR '${filter3_value}' = 'All' OR json_extract(metric_labels, '$.' || '${filter3_key}') = '${filter3_value}')

options.content: sample count: ${samples_count}, average value: ${avg_value}, max value: ${max_value}, min value: ${min_value}

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT metric_labels, ROUND(AVG(metric_value), 6) AS avg_value, ROUND(MIN(metric_value), 6) AS min_value, ROUND(MAX(metric_value), 6) AS max_value, COUNT(*) AS samples FROM ${_table} qr JOIN clusters c ON qr.cluster_id = c.id WHERE ('${kpi}' = 'All' OR kpi_id = '${kpi}') AND ('${cluster}' = 'All' OR c.cluster_name = '${cluster}') AND ('${cluster_type}' = 'All' OR c.cluster_type = '${cluster_type}') AND ('${filter1_key}' = 'All' OR '${filter1_value}' = 'All' OR json_extract(metric_labels, '$.' || '${filter1_key}') = '${filter1_value}') AND ('${filter2_key}' = 'All' OR '${filter2_value}' = 'All' OR json_extract(metric_labels, '$.' || '${filter2_key}') = '${filter2_value}') AND ('${filter3_key}' = 'All' OR '${filter3_value}' = 'All' OR json_extract(metric_labels, '$.' || '${filter3_key}') = '${filter3_value}') GROUP BY metric_labels ORDER BY avg_value DESC LIMIT 100
SELECT kpi_id AS metric, errors AS value FROM query_errors WHERE errors > 0 ORDER BY errors DESC;

SELECT kpi_id, COUNT(*) AS sample_count, ROUND(AVG(metric_value), 6) AS avg_value, ROUND(MIN(metric_value), 6) AS min_value, ROUND(MAX(metric_value), 6) AS max_value, ROUND(MAX(metric_value) - MIN(metric_value), 6) AS range, COUNT(DISTINCT metric_labels) AS unique_metrics FROM ${_table} qr JOIN clusters c ON qr.cluster_id = c.id WHERE ('${cluster}' = 'All' OR c.cluster_name = '${cluster}') AND ('${cluster_type}' = 'All' OR c.cluster_type = '${cluster_type}') AND ('${filter1_key}' = 'All' OR '${filter1_value}' = 'All' OR json_extract(metric_labels, '$.' || '${filter1_key}') = '${filter1_value}') AND ('${filter2_key}' = 'All' OR '${filter2_value}' = 'All' OR json_extract(metric_labels, '$.' || '${filter2_key}') = '${filter2_value}') AND ('${filter3_key}' = 'All' OR '${filter3_value}' = 'All' OR json_extract(metric_labels, '$.' || '${filter3_key}') = '${filter3_value}') GROUP BY kpi_id ORDER BY kpi_id

SELECT c.cluster_name, c.cluster_type, COUNT(DISTINCT qr.kpi_id) AS kpi_count, COUNT(*) AS total_samples, MAX(qr.created_at) AS last_collection FROM clusters c LEFT JOIN ${_table} qr ON c.id = qr.cluster_id WHERE ('${cluster_type}' = 'All' OR c.cluster_type = '${cluster_type}') AND ('${cluster}' = 'All' OR c.cluster_name = '${cluster}') AND ('${filter1_key}' = 'All' OR '${filter1_value}' = 'All' OR json_extract(qr.metric_labels, '$.' || '${filter1_key}') = '${filter1_value}') AND ('${filter2_key}' = 'All' OR '${filter2_value}' = 'All' OR json_extract(qr.metric_labels, '$.' || '${filter2_key}') = '${filter2_value}') AND ('${filter3_key}' = 'All' OR '${filter3_value}' = 'All' OR json_extract(qr.metric_labels, '$.' || '${filter3_key}') = '${filter3_value}') GROUP BY c.cluster_name, c.cluster_type ORDER BY c.cluster_name

list.name: cluster_type
list.label: Cluster Type
list.query: SELECT cluster_type FROM (SELECT 'All' AS cluster_type, 1 AS sort_order UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT cluster_type, 2 AS sort_order FROM clusters WHERE cluster_type IS NOT NULL AND cluster_type <> '') ORDER BY sort_order, cluster_type;

list.name: cluster
list.label: Cluster
list.query: SELECT cluster_name FROM (SELECT DISTINCT c.cluster_name, c.created_at, 1 AS sort_order FROM clusters c WHERE c.cluster_name IS NOT NULL AND c.cluster_name <> '' AND ('${cluster_type}' = 'All' OR c.cluster_type = '${cluster_type}') UNION ALL SELECT 'All', '0000-01-01', 2) ORDER BY sort_order, created_at DESC, cluster_name;

list.name: category
list.label: Category
list.query: SELECT category FROM (SELECT 'default' AS category, 1 AS sort_order UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT category, 2 AS sort_order FROM kpi_registry WHERE category IS NOT NULL AND category <> '') ORDER BY sort_order, category;

list.name: _table
list.query: SELECT CASE WHEN '${category}' = 'default' THEN 'query_results' ELSE 'kpi_' || '${category}' END;

list.name: kpi
list.label: KPI
list.query: SELECT kpi_id FROM (SELECT DISTINCT kpi_id, 1 AS sort_order FROM ${_table} WHERE kpi_id IS NOT NULL AND kpi_id <> '' UNION ALL SELECT 'All', 2) ORDER BY sort_order, kpi_id;

list.name: filter1_key
list.label: Filter 1 Label
list.query: SELECT key FROM (SELECT 'All' AS key, 1 AS sort_order UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT je.key, 2 FROM ${_table}, json_each(metric_labels) AS je WHERE ('${kpi}' = 'All' OR kpi_id = '${kpi}') AND metric_labels IS NOT NULL AND je.key <> '__name__') ORDER BY sort_order, key;

list.name: filter1_value
list.label: Filter 1 Value
list.query: SELECT value FROM (SELECT 'All' AS value, 1 AS sort_order UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT json_extract(metric_labels, '$.' || '${filter1_key}'), 2 FROM ${_table} WHERE ('${kpi}' = 'All' OR kpi_id = '${kpi}') AND '${filter1_key}' <> 'All' AND metric_labels IS NOT NULL AND json_extract(metric_labels, '$.' || '${filter1_key}') IS NOT NULL AND json_extract(metric_labels, '$.' || '${filter1_key}') <> '') ORDER BY sort_order, value;

list.name: filter2_key
list.label: Filter 2 Label
list.query: SELECT key FROM (SELECT 'All' AS key, 1 AS sort_order UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT je.key, 2 FROM ${_table}, json_each(metric_labels) AS je WHERE ('${kpi}' = 'All' OR kpi_id = '${kpi}') AND metric_labels IS NOT NULL AND je.key <> '__name__') ORDER BY sort_order, key;

list.name: filter2_value
list.label: Filter 2 Value
list.query: SELECT value FROM (SELECT 'All' AS value, 1 AS sort_order UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT json_extract(metric_labels, '$.' || '${filter2_key}'), 2 FROM ${_table} WHERE ('${kpi}' = 'All' OR kpi_id = '${kpi}') AND '${filter2_key}' <> 'All' AND metric_labels IS NOT NULL AND json_extract(metric_labels, '$.' || '${filter2_key}') IS NOT NULL AND json_extract(metric_labels, '$.' || '${filter2_key}') <> '') ORDER BY sort_order, value;

list.name: filter3_key
list.label: Filter 3 Label
list.query: SELECT key FROM (SELECT 'All' AS key, 1 AS sort_order UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT je.key, 2 FROM ${_table}, json_each(metric_labels) AS je WHERE ('${kpi}' = 'All' OR kpi_id = '${kpi}') AND metric_labels IS NOT NULL AND je.key <> '__name__') ORDER BY sort_order, key;

list.name: filter3_value
list.label: Filter 3 Value
list.query: SELECT value FROM (SELECT 'All' AS value, 1 AS sort_order UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT json_extract(metric_labels, '$.' || '${filter3_key}'), 2 FROM ${_table} WHERE ('${kpi}' = 'All' OR kpi_id = '${kpi}') AND '${filter3_key}' <> 'All' AND metric_labels IS NOT NULL AND json_extract(metric_labels, '$.' || '${filter3_key}') IS NOT NULL AND json_extract(metric_labels, '$.' || '${filter3_key}') <> '') ORDER BY sort_order, value;

list.name: samples_count
list.query: SELECT COALESCE(COUNT(*), 0) FROM ${_table} qr JOIN clusters c ON qr.cluster_id = c.id WHERE ('${kpi}' = 'All' OR kpi_id = '${kpi}') AND ('${cluster}' = 'All' OR c.cluster_name = '${cluster}') AND ('${cluster_type}' = 'All' OR c.cluster_type = '${cluster_type}') AND ('${filter1_key}' = 'All' OR '${filter1_value}' = 'All' OR json_extract(metric_labels, '$.' || '${filter1_key}') = '${filter1_value}') AND ('${filter2_key}' = 'All' OR '${filter2_value}' = 'All' OR json_extract(metric_labels, '$.' || '${filter2_key}') = '${filter2_value}') AND ('${filter3_key}' = 'All' OR '${filter3_value}' = 'All' OR json_extract(metric_labels, '$.' || '${filter3_key}') = '${filter3_value}')

list.name: avg_value
list.query: SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(metric_value), 6), 'N/A') FROM ${_table} qr JOIN clusters c ON qr.cluster_id = c.id WHERE ('${kpi}' = 'All' OR kpi_id = '${kpi}') AND ('${cluster}' = 'All' OR c.cluster_name = '${cluster}') AND ('${cluster_type}' = 'All' OR c.cluster_type = '${cluster_type}') AND ('${filter1_key}' = 'All' OR '${filter1_value}' = 'All' OR json_extract(metric_labels, '$.' || '${filter1_key}') = '${filter1_value}') AND ('${filter2_key}' = 'All' OR '${filter2_value}' = 'All' OR json_extract(metric_labels, '$.' || '${filter2_key}') = '${filter2_value}') AND ('${filter3_key}' = 'All' OR '${filter3_value}' = 'All' OR json_extract(metric_labels, '$.' || '${filter3_key}') = '${filter3_value}')

list.name: min_value
list.query: SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(MIN(metric_value), 6), 'N/A') FROM ${_table} qr JOIN clusters c ON qr.cluster_id = c.id WHERE ('${kpi}' = 'All' OR kpi_id = '${kpi}') AND ('${cluster}' = 'All' OR c.cluster_name = '${cluster}') AND ('${cluster_type}' = 'All' OR c.cluster_type = '${cluster_type}') AND ('${filter1_key}' = 'All' OR '${filter1_value}' = 'All' OR json_extract(metric_labels, '$.' || '${filter1_key}') = '${filter1_value}') AND ('${filter2_key}' = 'All' OR '${filter2_value}' = 'All' OR json_extract(metric_labels, '$.' || '${filter2_key}') = '${filter2_value}') AND ('${filter3_key}' = 'All' OR '${filter3_value}' = 'All' OR json_extract(metric_labels, '$.' || '${filter3_key}') = '${filter3_value}')

list.name: max_value
list.query: SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(MAX(metric_value), 6), 'N/A') FROM ${_table} qr JOIN clusters c ON qr.cluster_id = c.id WHERE ('${kpi}' = 'All' OR kpi_id = '${kpi}') AND ('${cluster}' = 'All' OR c.cluster_name = '${cluster}') AND ('${cluster_type}' = 'All' OR c.cluster_type = '${cluster_type}') AND ('${filter1_key}' = 'All' OR '${filter1_value}' = 'All' OR json_extract(metric_labels, '$.' || '${filter1_key}') = '${filter1_value}') AND ('${filter2_key}' = 'All' OR '${filter2_value}' = 'All' OR json_extract(metric_labels, '$.' || '${filter2_key}') = '${filter2_value}') AND ('${filter3_key}' = 'All' OR '${filter3_value}' = 'All' OR json_extract(metric_labels, '$.' || '${filter3_key}') = '${filter3_value}')

list.name: data_start
list.query: SELECT COALESCE(CAST(MIN(timestamp_value) * 1000 AS INTEGER), 0) FROM ${_table} qr JOIN clusters c ON qr.cluster_id = c.id WHERE ('${kpi}' = 'All' OR kpi_id = '${kpi}') AND ('${cluster}' = 'All' OR c.cluster_name = '${cluster}') AND ('${cluster_type}' = 'All' OR c.cluster_type = '${cluster_type}')

list.name: data_end
list.query: SELECT COALESCE(CAST(MAX(timestamp_value) * 1000 AS INTEGER), 0) FROM ${_table} qr JOIN clusters c ON qr.cluster_id = c.id WHERE ('${kpi}' = 'All' OR kpi_id = '${kpi}') AND ('${cluster}' = 'All' OR c.cluster_name = '${cluster}') AND ('${cluster_type}' = 'All' OR c.cluster_type = '${cluster_type}')
